sources.title: Fresh isolated source-first URL parser review

claims.text: The preserved source asks for URL-to-JSON parsing across protocol, domain, path and query special cases; schema and repeated-key policy are candidate contracts.
Node.js 22 exposes WHATWG URL hostname, port, pathname and URLSearchParams APIs used by the implementation.
Writer and reviewer validations exercise exact behavior over special-case fixtures and thousands of generated absolute URLs.

validation.command: extract exact candidate JavaScript block and run independent deterministic plus generated fixtures under Node 22
validation.reported_stdout: PASS exact_candidate fixtures=6 invalid=3 generated=7000 repeated-query=preserved ipv6=covered opaque=covered proto-keys=covered absolute-only=enforced
checks: 6 independent fixtures cover default/custom port, IPv6, opaque scheme, encoding and dangerous query keys
7000 generated absolute URL fixtures preserve known components and repeated query keys

findings: The preserved source explicitly asks for URL-to-JSON parsing across protocol, domain, path and query special cases; the exact JSON schema, absolute-only policy and repeated-key array rule are labeled candidate contracts.
Node.js 22 official URL documentation was fetched source-first and frozen before review for hostname, port, pathname and URLSearchParams accessors.
The candidate delegates URL syntax and normalization to the platform WHATWG URL parser instead of claiming a hand-written regex covers all schemes, IPv6 and encoding cases.

The exact candidate executes under Node 22 and passes independent fixtures for IPv6, default and non-default ports, opaque scheme, encoding, repeated/empty query values and prototype-sensitive keys, plus 7000 generated absolute URLs.
The null-prototype query object and Object.hasOwn avoid treating __proto__ as an inherited setter/key collision.
The answer clearly separates pathname serialization from URLSearchParams query decoding and avoids implicit business-type coercion.
No fabricated production experience is claimed.
